Instead of stopping the entire application to perform a garbage collection cycle, the garbage collector performs small, incremental garbage collections in the background as the application runs.

passages.before:
collector deallocates all objects that are not marked as live. This phase is also concurrent, and it runs in parallel with the application threads.
